title: Verify step and inspection channel parity
changes: Record same-seed three-channel parity for readonly inspection and a neutral one-frame step.
validation: Three isolated sessions from the same pinned seed used local-control CLI, menu parameter forms and interactive command console respectively. Origin frame, clock, CPU registers and state hash matched; inspecting 16 ROM bytes preserved guest state. The complete inspection results and one-frame endpoint frame, clock, registers, keys, reason and state hash matched exactly.
All three validation units and a separate six-input comparison unit passed with protected input hashes; GUI sessions closed normally.

A separate EUR Wine/Xvfb session verified the same zero-length inspection and zero-frame step refusal text in parameter forms and the parser. The command console copied identical structured parse-error JSON to debug-command for those cases, leading-zero decimals, unprefixed addresses and an unknown command; direct local-control CLI also refused zero bounds. Guest frame, clock, registers, keys and state hash remained unchanged.
The first refusal driver incorrectly used Ctrl+A in the append-only form and tested a different value; the corrected Backspace-based run passed with protected inputs and normal GUI closure.
limitations: This covers default arguments and a single EUR interpreter seed with simulated input; nondefault values, other error outcomes, native Windows and full DBG2-13 parity remain unverified. The first comparison helper used its scratch directory as the repository root and failed before reading inputs; its corrected retry passed.
